mentions.name: Video Hub App
mentions.description: A video browser application that displays thumbnails from videos as the mouse hovers, letting users visually browse their video collections. An optional facial recognition feature for searching by face similarity is planned, and minor improvements are currently being added.
mentions.source_excerpt: My 8-year-old video browser software Video Hub App - shows thumbnails from video as you hover with your mouse. Working on adding minor improvements before I finally get to the (optional) facial recognition "search by face similarity" feature.
